card.name: Sentence-ending period in web prose
card.fires_on: The period (or occasionally a colon) that ends a full sentence in general web text, just before a new sentence or section starts. Seen mostly in history, education and science prose.

modes.label: Period closing a sentence
modes.description: A full stop at the end of a declarative sentence, with a new sentence or heading following.

modes.label: Colon introducing a quote
modes.description: A colon ending a sentence and leading into a quotation.
